argv:
for f in .ufo/evidence/round-12/BashWitness/summary.json .ufo/evidence/round-12/BashWitness/declaration.json .ufo/evidence/round-12/BashWitness/declared.tsv .ufo/evidence/round-12/BashWitness/rerun-20261020T035435Z/summary.json .ufo/evidence/round-13/expected.json .ufo/evidence/round-13/witness-metadata.json .ufo/evidence/round-13/witness-metadata-old-null.json .ufo/evidence/round-13/pin-manifest.json .ufo/evidence/round-13/producer-before.py .ufo/evidence/round-13/producer-oracle.py; do echo "== $f sha256=$(sha256sum < $f | cut -c1-64) commits=$(git log --format=%h -- $f | tr '\n' ' ')"; done
echo "-- baseline commit in expected.json:"; git cat-file -t 546b371a48a2f6bd1e7dca6ae8aee2a6dc1b0a50; git log -1 --format='%H %cI %s' 546b371a48a2f6bd1e7dca6ae8aee2a6dc1b0a50
echo "-- tools/pin-disposition.py sha at each commit:"; for c in $(git log --format=%H -- tools/pin-disposition.py); do printf "%s %s %s\n" "$c" "$(git log -1 --format=%cI $c)" "$(git show $c:tools/pin-disposition.py | sha256sum | cut -c1-64)"; done
echo "-- tools/witness-metadata.py sha at each commit:"; for c in $(git log --format=%H -- tools/witness-metadata.py); do printf "%s %s %s\n" "$c" "$(git log -1 --format=%cI $c)" "$(git show $c:tools/witness-metadata.py | sha256sum | cut -c1-64)"; done
